name: print-social-creative-ninja-relax-grow-brand-poster-navy-yellow
title: 'You Can Relax As We Grow Your Brand' poster with a yellow blob, flat illustration and underlined red 'BRAND'
whatItIs: A navy-bordered white poster for 'Creative Ninja' with a big yellow organic blob behind a three-line headline in mixed weights ('You can RELAX as we GROW your' then huge red underlined 'BRAND'), a flat illustration of a person waving beside a laptop and a coin-sprouting plant, a lightbulb icon and a services list in black label bars.
whatItMeans: Confident and reassuring; the relaxed illustration and playful blob take the pressure out of a business pitch.
techniques: Vary weight and colour within one multi-line headline for emphasis.
Place a flat illustration on a simple organic blob backdrop.
List services as solid black label bars for quick scanning.

vocabulary.definition: An irregular rounded shape used behind a subject.
A solid block holding a short line of text.
